title.en: Hard cap breach imminent — manual action needed

titleFormatted.en: Hard cap breach imminent — no managed devices left to limit

hint.en: Fires when PELS expects one part of your home to exceed its hard cap this hour, with every managed device there already turned off or at its lowest step. The [[home]] tag names that part: the Main home, or a meter area by name. Use it to alert someone to go and turn something off by hand. Daily budget overruns do not fire this trigger.
